info.name: Airline Platform
info.description:
End-to-end tests for every flow in the airline platform, in order. Run the whole collection (Runner, or `npx newman run`) or step through folder by folder.

Prerequisites: databases + Kafka in Docker, services started with scripts/start-local.ps1 (payment-service uses the offline `payment-stub` profile, so no Razorpay account is needed). See postman/README.md.

item.name: 00 Prepare run
item.description: Generates unique codes and emails so the collection can be run again and again against the same databases.

request.description: Any public call works here; the point is the pre-request script, which creates unique test data.

exec: const pick = n => Array.from({length: n}, () => letters[Math.floor(Math.random() * 26)]).join("");
// A flight 5 days from now, 06:10 to 08:25 (local date-times, as the API expects)

item.name: 01 Sign up and log in
item.description: Flow: Sign up and log in. Creates a customer, a second customer and an airline owner, and logs in the bootstrap admin.

request.description: The first admin is created at startup from BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL / BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_PASSWORD (local profile default: admin@airline.local / ChangeMe!Local123).

NEGATIVE: wrong password gives the generic error

exec: pm.test("same message as unknown email", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Invalid email or password"));

exec: pm.test("same message as wrong password", () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().detail).to.eql("Invalid email or password"));

request.description: Before hardening, these headers made any user an admin. The gateway now strips them.

item.name: 02 Reference data (admin)
item.description: Cities and airports. Writes are admin-only; reads are public.

item.name: NEGATIVE: customer cannot create a city
03 Airline onboarding
item.description: Flow: Airline onboarding. PENDING_APPROVAL -> ACTIVE by an admin.

item.name: Owner creates airline (tries to set ACTIVE)

request.description: The body asks for "ACTIVE". The server ignores it: new airlines always start PENDING_APPROVAL.

item.name: NEGATIVE: owner cannot approve own airline
04 Fleet and seat setup
item.description: Flow: Fleet and seat setup. Aircraft -> cabin class -> seat map (generates seats).

request.description: Creating the seat map generates the physical seats 1A..10F (window, middle, aisle).

item.name: 05 Publishing flights
item.description: Flow: Publishing flights. Creating an instance publishes flight-instance.created; seat-service builds the seat inventory asynchronously.

item.name: Owner creates a dated flight instance

request.description: An overnight schedule (23:30 -> 01:45). Each generated instance arrives the next day.

exec: pm.test("overnight arrival is the next day", () => pm.expect(overnight.arrivalDateTime.slice(0, 10) > overnight.departureDateTime.slice(0, 10)).to.be.true);

request.description: Polls until seat-service has consumed flight-instance.created, then picks seats for the tests.

exec: setTimeout(() => {}, 1500); // events are asynchronous: give Kafka consumers a moment
pm.test("reached expected seat inventory", () => pm.expect(body.content.length > 0 && body.content[0].seats.length > 0).to.be.true);

item.name: 06 Fares and extras
item.description: Flow: Fares and extras. A fare per cabin, plus a meal and an ancillary offered on the flight.

item.name: Owner offers the meal on the flight
07 Flight search
item.description: Flow: Flight search. Public, no token.

item.name: 08 Checkout and pay by webhook
item.description: Flows: Checkout, then Payment succeeds. Razorpay's webhook is simulated: the body is signed with the webhook secret, exactly like Razorpay does.

item.name: Customer books seat 1 with a meal and a bag
Find the new booking id in my history

request.description: POST /api/bookings returns the payment, not the booking id. A real frontend gets the id from the Razorpay callback URL (/booking-success/{bookingId}); here we read it from the booking history.

exec: pm.test("booking found by its payment id", () => pm.expect(b).to.be.an("object"));

item.name: Booking is PENDING with a price breakdown
